decisions.claim: Do the eleven complete middle surfaces in GDT803’s twelve left-Xl-right brackets recur in independently rebuilt field neighborhoods, and does that distinguish a content/quality field from an opaque three-field address?
decisions.scope: The twelve GDT803 complete-context brackets and their eleven exact middle forms, as reassessed by GDT804. Foreign-anchor field reconstruction is distinct from independent semantic identification.
decisions.actually_tested_falsifier: GDT804 masks all155 paired Xl forms and rebuilds72 fields from other inherited whole-role anchors. It observes18/45 exposed middle-form cells in those fields. Under aggregate matching, hit-count p=.00019996 and hit-rate p=.00239952; the hit-rate changes to p=.371076289 under individual ten-neighbor matching and p=.536934631 under its leave-ol-out variant. It also finds15 preferred-side amount neighbors, none of those selected sides being a previously licensed GDT760 CONTENT_PREP contact. These are target-masked field-association and licensing checks, not independently decoded content roles.
decisions.outcome: The zero open-deck intersection is a selection fact, not content refutation. The 18/45 association and 15 positional candidates do not establish a uniform content role; no universal 50-edge or preferred-side gate is added. The opaque address and descriptive/prescriptive field readings remain live.
decisions.claim_ceiling: No uniform noun/material slot, free l/m meaning, portable individual context rule or semantic confirmation.

11.3728 Treffer

35.1998;

reopening.criteria_origin: Prospective question-specific root adjudication, not a historical preregistration or execution permission.
all_of: State whether the new question concerns structural field association, a named whole content role or the complete three-field meaning. For semantic selection, independently bind the property/role on which the chosen field and opaque-address models actually differ; an opaque address may also occur in meaningful fields. evidence.quote:
## The balanced six-event bridge

Each surface has one celestial source label, one non-celestial local label and
one non-celestial running paragraph:

| surface | circle source | visible non-circle label | running paragraph | external domain |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `okaldy` | f72r2.27, member 05A | f82r.37, upper pool figure 3 | f75r:P2, lines 27–31 | figure/station system 2/2 |
| `otaldy` | f70v2.17, member 26A | f88r.12, Gabelwurzelstock | f95v1:P1, lines 1–5 | plant/drug material 2/2 |

The four off-circle host units therefore separate 4/4 by complete surface. A
leave-one-host-out surface model recovers 4/4; a family-pooled modal model
recovers 0/4 on the same balanced micro-panel.

## Controls

All eleven recurrent GDT795 families were searched after all 101 source-circle
loci were removed. Five have external contacts and three have enough repeated
surface capacity for a direct comparison:

| family | external host units | keyed accuracy | pooled accuracy | gain |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `AQABBA` | 4 | 1.000 | 0.000 | +1.000 |
| `AQAB` | 30 | .259 | .345 | -.086 |
| `AQABA` | 9 | .375 | .625 | -.250 |

`AQABBA` is the only qualified family with positive surface-specific gain.
This is not a strong probability claim: with only two contacts per surface,
the complete six-permutation micro-null gives `p=.333333`.

A second calibration profiled all 71 single-token source surfaces. Twenty-one
recur externally and nine have some local-label/running-paragraph bridge. Only
`okaldy` and `otaldy` are minimal non-celestial bridges with exactly one local
label and one running paragraph in the same domain. This descriptive pattern
was explored before the final build; it is useful symmetry, not independent
confirmation.

The broader `ok...` versus `ot...` direction is weak and cluster-confounded:
its 20 target-excluded units are surface×host contacts, not twenty independent
host clusters. In `AQAB/AQABA`, the figure-versus-plant table is 7/4 for
`ok...` and 4/5 for `ot...` (`OR=2.1875`, Fisher `p=.653417`). No `ok` or `ot`
component meaning follows.

## Historical layer and renderer repair

GDT796's Picatrix H0/H1 transforms put the two source labels under Jupiter and
Venus. This keeps a Jupiter-/Venus facies class as a source-register C0 rival.
The Chaldean comparator changes the status, and no off-circle paragraph
independently names a planet, decan or benefic quality. Nothing exports into
prose.

Four off-circle occurrences receive the direct contextual C0 displays. The two
circle labels receive a weaker hybrid prediction that prints both the learned
article rival and `AQABBA:Faciesklasse?`; their visible circle context does not
independently prove bath or root/drug content. The GDT734 cache has the old
GDT666 action at f88r.12 and f95v1.4; both are quarantined. That phrase was
composed from analyst components `O_PREP+T_COLD+AL_RAW_I+DY_FINISHED`.
One-word radial and Gabelwurzelstock labels contradict an imperative process
clause. No substring or unseen occurrence inherits either new display.

reopening.criteria_origin: Prospective source-specific root conditions, not a new alignment search or execution permission.
all_of: Select the circle-status or off-circle content commitment before designing the test. A planetary-status claim needs genuinely changed independently supported alignment/status evidence or a different predeclared falsifier; another sweep over arbitrary transforms or inherited planet assignments is insufficient. A content-domain test needs a declared complete-surface/readership cohort and changed independently constrained host/content evidence. Such a result does not retroactively identify the circle planet class. Apply the relevant provenance/capacity gates to the actual proposed test, not a universal edge threshold.
not_sufficient: The existing4/4 micro-panel split or its p=.333333 called a planetary identification.
A failure on AQABAC silently applied to AQABBA.
A new name or transform choice on the same historical alignment treated as an independent anchor.
